HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   B. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   D. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   B. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

6. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.

   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   C. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict Resolutions in Independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Russian Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
